title: A measuring device with no segmentation: one landmark pass, then arithmetic
caption: A proposed reader for SchwingCheck: one keypoint pass per frame, lengths in pixels, millimetres from the C-arm's geometry, then the posterior. The two timed parts sit far inside one frame's 97 ms; the parts to build are untimed, and the lengths must reach about 1 mm for the guarantee to hold.

source.notes: A design with no outcome. The detector's 6.8 ms and corner accuracy are chapter 12's (Reported); the posterior's time and the 3 mm result are bordercall's records; the budget is docs/memory/latency-and-the-recorded-sweep.md.
